positive.not_applicable_reason: Native qualifier verifies 300 exhaustive small minima, 2520 point actions, retained labels and planted multicolumn/leading cases; analyzer synthetic planted gain/noise controls are separate software tests, not timing data.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Altered programs and expected point outputs reject; analyzer rejects invalid matrices, source/receipt bindings, arithmetic subphase costs and A/A or primary selection errors.

factors.name: curve and mu
factors.how: Original five saved labels and common serialized request; no generator or point-specific tuning.

factors.name: point
factors.how: Frozen60-point manifest, full-width SHA256 expansion with panel/curve/index/block domains; no input logarithm passed to candidate.

factors.name: candidate plan
factors.how: Prepared inside each call. Installed artifact is a separate secondary arm, with loading/parsing charged.

factors.name: instrument and environment
factors.value: One worker binary/backend, one thread, same input/output checks
factors.how: Bind binary/header/worker/analysis/isolation hashes and environment before freeze.

factors.name: order
factors.value: Fixed seeded per-round shuffle of25 configurations
factors.how: Retain one warmup+6rounds, every row and five exclusive phases.

factors.name: host
factors.value: Native exclusive-core admission with full SMT pair
factors.how: Reject contended/failed receipts; enforce PSI and other-CPU thresholds without fallback.

factors.name: block planner
factors.value: maximum span16; exact D+A,negation,D,step lexicographic key; offset0/window heuristic unchanged
factors.how: Recode, bank-label construction, DP states/transitions/allocations and reconstruction all inside plan_ns. Point bank construction/normalization plus destruction are inside arithmetic_ns. No plan is reused across points or calls.

randomization.arm_order_reason: Per-round seeded shuffle; every configuration and point retained.

seed_derivation.note: Worker literal0x43414348455632 + round + heldout offset1009; point-domain cm-cache-cold-v2.

instance_sampling.rule: Five curves;20calibration and40heldout points;25configurations;one warmup+6rounds:3500+7000 rows.

blinding.how: Mechanical deterministic analysis predeclared; algorithm phases and source labels are visible. No analyst choices after held-out data.

power.note: Complete finite designed panel; every held-out point must beat the fastest of all11 reference configurations and the maximum paired A/A envelope. No population significance or power claim.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: No timing pilot;120-second deadline per panel. One attempt each, no unchanged retries.

primary.name: cold verified per-point time
primary.definition: Total cold nanoseconds from before request parse until required objects are destroyed and verified encoded output exists. Five exclusive phases sum to total.
primary.source: rows.jsonl total_ns; one complete cold call per row; no division
primary.resolution: steady_clock nanoseconds; hardware resolution and host recorded

secondary.name: Exclusive phase costs
secondary.resolution: native monotonic clock; host resolution recorded

secondary.name: Point-bank setup and loop/destruction subphases
secondary.definition: For block arms bank_setup_ns+loop_bank_destroy_ns=arithmetic_ns exactly; these nested times are not added again to total
secondary.source: raw block JSONL; null for reference-internal phases not exposed

secondary.name: Complete group and planner event counts
secondary.definition: One untimed 125-row matrix across five curves and25 configurations: includes actual prefix/table D/A/N, retained points, DP transitions and folded blocks. Unknown API internals remain null. No time inferred from event counts.
secondary.source: counts.jsonl; all clock fields zero and timing_performed=false

measurement.timed_primary_justification: The requested end-to-end latency depends on native field/backend, normalization, table setup and conversions; isolated wall time is required. Historical counted arithmetic is preserved as a separate baseline.

stopping_rules.rule: Stop after3500calibration and7000heldout rows, or retain the first admission refusal/timeout/failure without resizing.
Any wrong output, missing/duplicate row, phase sum, binding or admission failure invalidates the panel.
Collect one125-row untimed diagnostic matrix before admission; native summary must validate before calibration. No clock is read in diagnostic mode. Failed diagnostic stops this attempt.

invalidation_rules: a row with outcome.status other than verified is excluded from the decisive comparison and reported
a wall-time value on a row below L2 is descriptive only (wall_valid false); counted units stand at any level

decision_rule.text: Report calibration reference choice. At each heldout point use the fastest median across all11 regular/binary reference configurations. Per curve require minimum reference/block-default speedup > max(1.01,maximum bidirectional paired A/A median ratio across those references and points). Installed candidate is secondary only; report all five curves.
decision_rule.statistic: Minimum per-point fastest-reference speedup against deterministic block-default; maximum paired A/A envelope
decision_rule.interval: No population interval; strict finite-panel all-point criterion

graphs: S per arm per workload with the A/A interval
